name: Heather
source: Heather is a cat who often hangs out with Jeremy, Clint, and Micha. She grew up in Echo and is roughly the same age as the group having a reunion. Jenna seems to harbor ill will for Heather, but Heather views Jenna amicably. In high school, she briefly dated TJ.
